T-98: fix: Nginx proxy_pass URI mapping for API and WS
Mode: coding - 7/7 steps
Fin: 2026-07-06T04:14:47.2284985+01:00
[v] When variables are used in proxy_pass, appending a path (like \/api/\)
[v] causes Nginx to replace the entire normalized request URI with that
[v] exact string. This caused \/api/login\ to be forwarded as \/api/\,
[v] resulting in a 404 Route Not Found from the backend (which the frontend
[v] incorrectly displayed as 'Invalid credentials').
[v] By omitting the path suffix in \proxy_pass \;\, Nginx preserves
[v] and forwards the original request URI intact.

T-96: fix: correct AQ event timezone offset and ISO date parsing
2.0K$0.00
Mode: coding - 14/14 steps
Fin: 2026-07-06T04:00:37.4795000+01:00
[v] Root cause: Dockerfile had ORA_SDTZ=Africa/Lagos (UTC+1) instead of UTC,
[v] causing the oracledb driver to misinterpret plain TIMESTAMP values from
[v] Oracle AQ payloads. The JOB_EVENT_T.event_time field is TIMESTAMP (no TZ),
[v] populated with SYSTIMESTAMP whose digits are in the server's local timezone.
[v] When ORA_SDTZ was UTC+1, the driver created JS Date objects 1 hour ahead.
[v] Changes:
[v] Dockerfile: ORA_SDTZ=Africa/Lagos -> UTC
[v] aqConsumer.js: detect Oracle server TZ offset at connection time and
[v] apply correction to EVENT_TIME, START_TIME, END_TIME (safety net)
[v] parsers.ts: parseOracleDate now handles ISO 8601 strings with 'T'
[v] delimiter instead of returning null
[v] parsers.ts: getRuleFallbackTime uses parseOracleDateTimeLoose for
[v] robust hour/minute extraction from ISO timestamps
[v] Restores 7 CommonJS shim files for TypeScript forwarders
DONE
